# VOD / Series Detail Action Buttons — Style Review & Refinement

## Context

The user asked for a styling review of the large action buttons (Play, Resume, Restart, Favorite, Download) in the VOD and Series detail views, benchmarked against Netflix / Sky / Disney+ and other streaming platforms. The views in scope:

- `libs/ui/playback/src/lib/vod-details/vod-details.component.{ts,html}` (shared VOD details, used by Xtream VOD and Stalker VOD via the feature routes)
- `libs/portal/xtream/feature/src/lib/serial-details/serial-details.component.{ts,html}` (Xtream series)
- Shared button styles: `libs/ui/playback/src/lib/styles/detail-view.scss` and duplicated/overridden in `libs/portal/stalker/feature/src/lib/styles/detail-view.scss`

No Stalker VOD/Series-specific components exist — Stalker reuses `app-vod-details` and an equivalent pattern via `stalker-catalog-detail` + `stalker-series-view`; style fixes land in the shared SCSS and propagate automatically.

## Review — what works, what doesn't

### What already feels premium ✅

- `.play-btn` is well-crafted: 16px radius, 54px height, layered gradients, icon-shell with blur, hover lift, animated `launching` and `stop` states, reduced-motion support. This matches Sky/Disney+ "hero CTA" language.
- Theme tokens (`--play-idle-*`, `--play-stop-*`, light/dark) are correctly scoped on `:host`.
- Rating tag with gold accent is a nice streaming-UI touch.

### Inconsistencies / issues ❌

1. **Visual weight mismatch across the action row.** `.favorite-btn` / `.download-btn` are flat `rgba(109,109,110,0.7)` pills with **4px** radius and no min-height — next to the 16px-radius, 54px-tall, gradient `.play-btn` they look like a different design system. Netflix, Sky, Disney+ all keep the secondary actions at the **same height and radius** as the primary, just with a translucent/outlined surface.
2. **Arbitrary accent colors on secondary actions.** Download = blue (`rgba(33,150,243,.8)`), Download-complete = green, Favorite-active = Netflix red. Mixing three hues in one toolbar reads as a debug UI rather than a curated hero. Streaming UIs use **one accent** (the brand red / purple on the primary play CTA) and let icons + state carry meaning on secondary buttons.
3. **Missing `.play-btn--restart` modifier.** The HTML applies `play-btn play-btn--restart` but the SCSS has no `--restart` rule — so "Restart" currently inherits the full gradient treatment of the primary play button, creating **two primaries side-by-side**. Netflix/Sky pattern: big "Resume" primary + compact, low-emphasis "Play from beginning" next to it.
4. **No primary action in serial-details.** The series screen only shows a Favorite button above the seasons list. Every major streaming service ships a "Play S1·E1" / "Resume S3·E7" hero CTA on series pages; dropping straight into episode list feels unfinished.
5. **Duplicated SCSS.** `libs/ui/playback/.../detail-view.scss` and `libs/portal/stalker/feature/.../detail-view.scss` contain near-identical `.play-btn` rules (~300 lines). Future changes risk drifting.
6. **Accessibility gaps.** No `:focus-visible` ring, no `aria-pressed` on the favorite toggle, icon-only states rely on color alone.
7. **Mobile (`@media (max-width: 800px)`).** Buttons stretch to `flex: 1` and all become equally prominent — Netflix keeps Play full-width and collapses secondary actions to icon-only chips on narrow screens.

### Benchmark cues being used

- **Netflix**: primary Play = white with black icon; secondary (My List, Share) = `rgba(109,109,110,0.7)` **same height** as play; active My List = filled ✓ on same gray, not red.
- **Sky Stream / NOW**: primary = brand purple gradient; secondary = translucent glass with 1px border, all 48–52px high, matching radius.
- **Disney+**: primary = solid white with inner shadow; secondary = ghost buttons with 1px white border, identical radius.
- **Prime Video**: primary = yellow-gold; secondary = dark glass with border.

Across all four: **uniform geometry, one accent, icons differentiate intent, active state is an icon-swap not a color-swap.**

## Proposed changes

### A. Unify secondary button geometry (shared `detail-view.scss`)

Refactor `.favorite-btn` / `.download-btn` to share a `.action-btn--secondary` base:

- `min-height: 54px`, `border-radius: 14px` (≈play-btn, 2px softer so primary still dominates)
- `padding: 12px 22px`, `font-size: 0.9375rem`, `font-weight: 600`
- Surface: `background: var(--action-secondary-bg)` = translucent glass (`rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` dark / `rgba(0,0,0,0.05)` light) with 1px `var(--action-secondary-border)`
- Hover: raise 1px, brighten surface by 6–8%, **no color change**
- Remove blue/green/red fills from download + favorite-active; express state via **icon swap + subtle accent ring** (`box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent-color)` when active for favorite; `color: var(--success)` only on the **icon**, not the whole button, when downloaded)

Add new CSS custom properties alongside existing `--play-*`:
```
--action-secondary-bg, --action-secondary-bg-hover, --action-secondary-border,
--action-secondary-fg, --action-success-icon, --action-accent-ring
```
with light + dark-theme overrides.

### B. Add `.play-btn--restart` low-emphasis modifier

Restart lives next to Resume and should be **tertiary**: icon-only or icon+short-label, 44–48px, ghost surface. New rule:
```scss
.play-btn--restart {
  --play-btn-bg: transparent;
  --play-btn-fg: var(--text-primary);
  --play-btn-border: var(--action-secondary-border);
  --play-btn-shadow: none;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font-weight: 500;
  .play-btn__icon-shell { display: none; }   // drop the glossy shell for secondary
}
```

### C. Add a primary "Play / Resume episode" CTA to `serial-details`

New computed on `SerialDetailsComponent`:

- `nextEpisode = computed(...)` → first episode with a saved `positionSeconds > 0` and `positionSeconds < durationSeconds - 30`, else first episode of Season 1.
- `nextEpisodeLabel = computed(...)` → `"Resume S{season}·E{ep}"` or `"Play S1·E1"`.
- `nextEpisodePosition = computed(...)` → seconds into that episode.

Template: add a `<button class="play-btn">` inside `hero-actions` above the existing favorite button, wired to `playEpisode(nextEpisode())`. Reuses existing play-btn styling — zero new CSS.

### D. Accessibility polish (shared `detail-view.scss`)

- `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-color); outline-offset: 3px; }` on all three button classes.
- In HTML: `[attr.aria-pressed]="isFavorite()"` on the favorite button; `aria-label` on icon-only restart; `aria-live="polite"` on the primary button's label span so the `launching → stop` transition is announced.

### E. Mobile refinements (`@media (max-width: 800px)`)

- Primary `.play-btn`: `flex: 1 1 100%` (full row).
- Secondary `.favorite-btn`, `.download-btn`, `.play-btn--restart`: collapse to `min-width: 48px`, hide the `__label`, keep icon only.

### F. De-duplicate SCSS

Delete `libs/portal/stalker/feature/src/lib/styles/detail-view.scss` (300+ dup lines) and point Stalker components at the canonical `libs/ui/playback/src/lib/styles/detail-view.scss` via `styleUrls`. Verify no Stalker-only overrides exist first with a diff of the two files; if any, migrate them as modifiers into the shared file.

## Files to modify

- `libs/ui/playback/src/lib/styles/detail-view.scss` — secondary button refactor, `--restart` modifier, focus styles, mobile rules, new custom properties
- `libs/ui/playback/src/lib/vod-details/vod-details.component.html` — `aria-pressed`, `aria-label` on restart, label-wrap span for `aria-live`
- `libs/portal/xtream/feature/src/lib/serial-details/serial-details.component.ts` — `nextEpisode` + label + position computed signals, `playNextEpisode()` method
- `libs/portal/xtream/feature/src/lib/serial-details/serial-details.component.html` — primary `<button class="play-btn">` with next-episode label
- `libs/portal/stalker/feature/src/lib/styles/detail-view.scss` — delete (after diff check) or replace with `@forward` of shared file
- `libs/portal/stalker/feature/src/lib/stalker-series-view/*` — mirror the series-level "Resume next episode" CTA if its template exposes a `hero-actions` slot (confirm during implementation)

## Verification

1. `nx build web` and `nx lint web` pass.
2. `nx serve electron-backend` — open an Xtream VOD, Xtream series, Stalker VOD, Stalker series. Visually confirm:
   - Primary Play vs Restart vs Favorite vs Download all share the same vertical rhythm.
   - Favorite toggles icon + accent ring, not full color swap.
   - Download colors collapse to one accent.
   - Series page shows "Resume S·E" primary CTA when a position exists, else "Play S1·E1".
3. Tab through the action row — each button shows a visible focus ring; screen reader announces `aria-pressed=true/false` on favorite.
4. Resize to <800px — primary stays full-width, secondaries collapse to icon chips.
5. Toggle `prefers-reduced-motion` — launching pulse disables (existing rule still applies).
6. Run `nx test web` for affected specs (vod-details, serial-details).
7. Assess whether `docs/architecture/` needs a note — likely yes: a short "Detail view action button system" subsection under the existing Xtream/Stalker docs describing the button hierarchy (primary / secondary / tertiary) and the shared SCSS ownership rule.

### What already feels premium ✅

- `.play-btn` is well-crafted: 16px radius, 54px height, layered gradients, icon-shell with blur, hover lift, animated `launching` and `stop` states, reduced-motion support. This matches Sky/Disney+ "hero CTA" language.
- Theme tokens (`--play-idle-*`, `--play-stop-*`, light/dark) are correctly scoped on `:host`.
- Rating tag with gold accent is a nice streaming-UI touch.

### Inconsistencies / issues ❌

1. **Visual weight mismatch across the action row.** `.favorite-btn` / `.download-btn` are flat `rgba(109,109,110,0.7)` pills with **4px** radius and no min-height — next to the 16px-radius, 54px-tall, gradient `.play-btn` they look like a different design system. Netflix, Sky, Disney+ all keep the secondary actions at the **same height and radius** as the primary, just with a translucent/outlined surface.
2. **Arbitrary accent colors on secondary actions.** Download = blue (`rgba(33,150,243,.8)`), Download-complete = green, Favorite-active = Netflix red. Mixing three hues in one toolbar reads as a debug UI rather than a curated hero. Streaming UIs use **one accent** (the brand red / purple on the primary play CTA) and let icons + state carry meaning on secondary buttons.
3. **Missing `.play-btn--restart` modifier.** The HTML applies `play-btn play-btn--restart` but the SCSS has no `--restart` rule — so "Restart" currently inherits the full gradient treatment of the primary play button, creating **two primaries side-by-side**. 4. **No primary action in serial-details.** The series screen only shows a Favorite button above the seasons list. Every major streaming service ships a "Play S1·E1" / "Resume S3·E7" hero CTA on series pages; dropping straight into episode list feels unfinished.

6. **Accessibility gaps.** No `:focus-visible` ring, no `aria-pressed` on the favorite toggle, icon-only states rely on color alone.
7. **Mobile (`@media (max-width: 800px)`).** Buttons stretch to `flex: 1` and all become equally prominent — Netflix keeps Play full-width and collapses secondary actions to icon-only chips on narrow screens.

### Benchmark cues being used

- **Netflix**: primary Play = white with black icon; secondary (My List, Share) = `rgba(109,109,110,0.7)` **same height** as play; active My List = filled ✓ on same gray, not red.
- **Sky Stream / NOW**: primary = brand purple gradient; secondary = translucent glass with 1px border, all 48–52px high, matching radius.
- **Disney+**: primary = solid white with inner shadow; secondary = ghost buttons with 1px white border, identical radius.
- **Prime Video**: primary = yellow-gold; secondary = dark glass with border.

Across all four: **uniform geometry, one accent, icons differentiate intent, active state is an icon-swap not a color-swap.**

  --play-btn-bg: transparent;
  --play-btn-fg: var(--text-primary);
  --play-btn-border: var(--action-secondary-border);

Build succeeds. Summary of changes:

**Styling (`libs/ui/playback/src/lib/styles/detail-view.scss`)** — Refactored `.favorite-btn` / `.download-btn` to match `.play-btn` geometry (54px height, 14px radius, translucent-glass surface). Removed ad-hoc blue/green/red fills — state now shown via icon color + accent ring. Added `.play-btn--restart` tertiary treatment (previously missing modifier was silently inheriting primary gradient). Added `:focus-visible` rings and mobile rule collapsing secondaries to icon-only chips with primary full-width.

**A11y (`vod-details.component.html`)** — Favorite button uses `favorite`/`favorite_border` icons + `aria-pressed`, Restart gets `aria-label`, primary label span is `aria-live="polite"` so the launching→stop transition is announced.

**Series hero CTA (`serial-details.component.{ts,html}`)** — New `nextEpisodeInfo` + `nextEpisodeLabel` computed signals pick the first in-progress episode (or S01·E01), added as a primary `play-btn` in `hero-actions`. Netflix/Sky pattern — no more empty series hero with only a Favorite button.

**De-duplication** — Stalker SCSS shrunk to 11 lines of typography overrides; `stalker-series-view` + `serial-details` + Xtream `vod-details-route` all now share the canonical `libs/ui/playback/src/lib/styles/detail-view.scss`.
